verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs confirm the `[[` shortcut for linking notes and a backlinks list of incoming links from other notes. Search can also filter notes by where they are backlinked to or from. Nothing in the evidence covers unlinked mentions or shows backlinks displayed with surrounding context, so the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: unlinked-mention detection, backlinks shown in context, hands-on or independent corroboration of the linking and backlink experience.
